name: popover
description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger for small interactive content: a list to pick from, a short form.

properties.value: Click or Enter / Space on the trigger
Moves into the panel on open and back to the trigger on close; Escape closes
Works inside Dialog and Sheet (same Radix layer stack)

constraints: Use for small interactive content tied to a trigger: the Combobox list, a short filter form.
Keep it small; a task that needs focus belongs in a Dialog.
Read-only previews on hover belong in HoverCard.

notes: Added 2026-10-15 (shadcn Popover on Radix) to rebuild Combobox: Base UI's list didn't work inside a Radix Dialog.

docs.intro:
# Popover

A floating panel anchored to a trigger for small interactive content: a list to pick from, a short form.

---

sections.title: What it is
sections.body:
Radix Popover. Same primitive family as Dialog, Sheet and Select, so it stays clickable inside a modal. First use: the Combobox list.

**Exports:** `Popover` · `PopoverTrigger` · `PopoverAnchor` · `PopoverContent`
